title: Cookie written from script without the Secure attribute in javascript — review required
description: document.cookie assignments bypass the server-side cookie API, so the Secure and HttpOnly attributes are whatever the script writes. A cookie set without Secure travels over plaintext HTTP and cannot carry HttpOnly at all, which means script injection can read it. The rule flags the assignment; whether the value is sensitive is a review decision.
remediation: Set cookies from the server with Secure and HttpOnly, or use the Cookie Store API with the attributes spelled out.
limitation: Lexical: matches a document.cookie assignment on one line without the Secure attribute; multi-statement builds are out of scope.
